text:
sam: Free pickup tonight in Temescal/Oakland: pair of Dell 27" monitors (P2719H) and a small BILLY bookcase. Monitors worked great until upgrade, no dead pixels, VESA mounts attached. Bookcase is the 3-shelf white one, a bit of edge wear. Moving at 7pm so would need gone by 8. Pics in thread. :truck:

rachel: Interested in the monitors. Can you confirm power cables included? Also HDMI or DP?

diego: I can help with pickup if you need a hand. I have a sedan.

sam: Yep power bricks + DP cables included. They were on a KVM but I removed cables for photos. Specs: 
```
Dell P2719H
- 27", 1920x1080, IPS
- VESA 100x100
- 60Hz
```

nina: BILLY shelf interested for my home office. How tall is it?

sam: Shelf is 31.5in x 11in x 41in (3-shelf). Light assembly required — screws in a labeled bag.

rachel: I can be there at 7:30 and take both monitors if diego can help load. Will DM contact. :thumbsup:

diego: Yep I can swing by at 7:30, happy to carry. Seatbacks fold flat in my hatch.

sam: OK monitors tentatively held for @rachel (+diego). Shelf reserved for @nina til 7:15. If someone else claims first Ill update.

moving-bot: Reminder: curbside pickups must not block driveway and please wear a mask when at the building lobby.

nina: I'll be there at 7 to grab the shelf. Do you need help taking it downstairs?

sam: If you can bring a small cart that'd be great. I'll have it partly disassembled. Thanks all. :)

rachel: DM sent with address and my phone. Thanks Sam!

sam: Claimed, posting here in case plans change. Will update with a final photo at 6:45.
